name: mcp-builder

summary.en: Anthropic’s guide to designing and implementing MCP servers in Python (FastMCP) or TypeScript, covering tool design, testing and evaluation.
summary.zh: Anthropic 出品，指导用 Python（FastMCP）或 TypeScript 设计和实现 MCP 服务，涵盖工具设计、测试与评估。

upstreamDescription: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
